}}'''Eban Vandes''' was an author.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Eban Vandes|EV}}

==History==
Eban wrote [[The History of the Stone of Tear]].  This book was read by [[Rand al'Thor]] following his occupation of the [[Stone of Tear|Stone]].{{ref/book|4|2}}  The book was an important informational source for teaching Rand about the fortress he had conquered.{{ref||EV}}
